metadata.description: Meta Ads e-commerce operating system for Claude Code — evidence-first account analysis, a creative learning system, and a fenced execution lane

plugins.name: meta-ads-os
plugins.description: Audits a D2C e-commerce Meta ad account end to end across 30 sections: connector discovery, pixel/CAPI/EMQ measurement, mandatory reconciliation of Meta's claim against Shopify and GA4, contribution-margin economics, account structure, bidding and learning phase, a full creative database rendered as a Top Creatives dashboard, fatigue and angle analysis, relevance and auction diagnostics, audiences, prospecting and retargeting, catalog, Advantage+, placements, funnel and post-click CRO, offers, SKU economics, geo and device, attribution and incrementality, Ad Library competitive context, hygiene, budget allocation, and an executive decision page with an opportunity matrix and a creative x product x offer scale matrix. Audit agents are read-only; every change to a live account goes through the fenced execution lane in EXECUTION-PROTOCOL.md.
